description: Monthly request credits left and used on the key serving this call, read from The Odds API usage headers. Says whether the odds and scores tools can return data right now and how large the plan is.
name: odds_api_quota

checked_at.description: When the balance was read, ISO 8601.

error.description: Present only when the balance is spent: always "account_limited". The read succeeded; the allowance behind the key did not survive it.

exhausted.description: True when no credits remain, so the metered odds and scores tools cannot return data.

found.description: False when The Odds API did not return usage headers on this response.

hint.description: Present when found is false: what to call instead to tell a spent quota from a bad key.

last_call_cost.description: Credits the caller's previous request consumed.

message.description: Present only when the balance is spent: names the monthly exhaustion, the anniversary reset, and the tools that still answer for free.

plan_requests.description: Plan size for the month (remaining + used).

reason.description: Present when found is false: why the balance could not be read.

remaining.description: Request credits left on the key for the current billing month.

used.description: Request credits already spent this billing month.

title: Odds Api Quota
